statement: Dolphin2609a Flatpak: corrected separate35second no-ROM MP/MP+Nunchuk profiles have empty owned dynamic traces. Each profile-owned child was explicitly terminated and verified gone before the next arm (two TERM, no KILL). Separate sandbox raw access and enumeration/open trace controls pass. Direct-scanner enumeration remains the first unestablished checkpoint; status write, Connect, ControllerInterface AddDevice and gyro remain unestablished, with no internal cause inferred. The initial pilot overlapped child lifetimes across profiles; its comparison is invalid and retained as a method limitation. No kernel unbind, game content or model change.
